correctness.rationale: For finite X, the subbase neighbourhood identity is proved including the empty intersection. The poset of signature blocks outside r_i is a finite down-set, so every outside block lies below a maximal outside block. Maximal outside blocks must each contain a negative valuation point; the converse follows by ascending to such a negative witness. The factors 2^b-1 count non-all-positive assignments in each disjoint maximal block; all other nonrobust states are free. Necessity and sufficiency for some topology follow from inclusion of the smallest topology. Maximum positivity and its multiplicity require one negative per maximal block, and the one-pass identity follows from two opposite interior inclusions. Independently executed finite checker verified topology and valuation conditions.

value.rationale: This is the complete labelled truth-set calibration spectrum of the minimal robust models proposed for annotated classification, rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical example. It determines when an annotation can be precisely its true robust core under any topology honoring the prescribed opens, exact numbers and probabilities of compatible independent multilabel assignments, sharp maximum possible positive-label size and optimizer multiplicity, and a canonical one-pass forced-robustness correction. Duplicate-signature blocks contribute nontrivial factors, directly reflecting indistinguishable feature signatures. The claim makes no unsupported learning-performance assertions.
